name: SC-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Biggs running with large fundraising edge
Minimal Democratic resources and no polling
model.rationale: The R+21 lean, Biggs's incumbency and roughly 12-to-1 fundraising advantage leave Lehmacher with no visible path, and prediction markets agree at about 95% Republican. With no polls or expert ratings, the forecast stays anchored to fundamentals.
model.watch: A major outside-spending surge for Lehmacher or a national Democratic wave environment could narrow the margin, though a seat this red is unlikely to flip.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
South Carolina's 3rd District is deeply Republican, with a partisan lean of about 21 points toward the GOP. First-term incumbent Sheri Biggs won the seat in 2024 and is running again, holding a large financial edge over Democrat Eunice Lehmacher, who has raised roughly $41,000. A Libertarian, Brian Corriea, is also on the ballot.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals. Prediction markets give Biggs about a 95% chance of winning. The district's composition and the resource gap make this a Safe Republican seat, with the only real question being the size of the winning margin.
